mapper.insert: INSERT INTO torrent_native_worker_instance (instance_id,lease_token,last_heartbeat_at,lease_until,status) VALUES(#{id},#{token}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now'), DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 45 SECOND)STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now','+45 seconds'), 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE torrent_native_worker_instance SET last_heartbeat_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now'), lease_until=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 45 SECOND)STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now','+45 seconds') WHERE instance_id=#{id} AND lease_token=#{token} AND status='ACTIVE' AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)REPLACE(lease_until,'T',' ') > STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM torrent_native_worker_instance WHERE instance_id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)REPLACE(lease_until,'T',' ') > STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM torrent_native_worker_instance WHERE instance_id=#{id} AND (status='STOPPED' OR lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)REPLACE(lease_until,'T',' ') <= STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now'))
mapper.update: UPDATE torrent_native_worker_instance SET status='STOPPED' WHERE instance_id=#{id} AND lease_token=#{token} AND status='ACTIVE'
